https://web.archive.org/web/20251207041908/https://www.travelwisconsin.com/county-parks/blackhawk-memorial-county-park-220549 (Wayback capture 2025-12-07 of the Wisconsin Department of Tourism listing, submitted by Lafayette Development Corporation / Argyle Village; the live page now 404s): 'Operated by Lafayette County, 120-acre Blackhawk Memorial County Park offers primitive camping sites ... Esri World Imagery (tools/sat.py, 2026-11-20) at 42.6617,-89.8793 (700 m): park road curving through floodplain woods between Bloody Lake (SE) and the Pecatonica oxbow channels (W/N, ~25-40 m wide); the camping road on the west runs under near-continuous canopy beside the backwater channel; open lawn only around the day-use area and ball field by County Y.

note: Lafayette County park at the Black Hawk War battlefield by Bloody Lake near Woodford, with two boat landings and a picnic shelter. Primitive camping along the park road beside the Pecatonica River and its backwaters; 2026 camper reports describe open lawn spots with no pads, portable toilets, well water at the entrance and pay-by-envelope fees. Pad size unclear: rigs reported only to 16 ft. --Claude
